description: Same subject, same headset, rest vs cued artifact

items.label: Resting, research headset
items.note: DSI-24, no task. This is what the tool should call clean.

items.label: Blinking on cue, research headset
items.note: Same electrode, same person, one minute later. Blinks every three seconds.

items.label: Clenching the jaw, research headset
items.note: Fast, broadband, and strongest at the temples. This is the one that ruins a recording.

items.label: Resting, consumer headband
items.note: Muse 2. Four electrodes, two of them just above the eyebrows.

items.label: Blinking on cue, consumer headband
items.note: AF7 and AF8 sit right over the eyes, so a blink lands square on them.

items.label: Blinking on cue, single electrode
items.note: One electrode at Fp1. There is no other channel to cross-check against.
